_note: SPT Metals, Inc. - a carbon bar distributor onboarded to prove the classification/derivation architecture generalizes past telecom billing. Weight-tiered pricing (Weight/ft x Base Cost/lb x Margin x CTL Factor, + Energy Surcharge, + Freight) is a structurally different formula family from the F1 payable-derivation math every other pack uses. This pack is data-only for classification/extraction, exactly like acme_freight - what it needs beyond that is one small hook (conventions.py) supplying the weight-tier margin table, the per-state freight-rate table, and the CTL adder, none of which are ever printed on the invoice - the same 'a fact the derivation needs that the page cannot supply' pattern digitaldirection's prior_balance_basis convention already established.
name: spt_metals

claim._why: SPT Metals invoices many different buyers (Golub Corp among them, but not exclusively), so the claim guards on the VENDOR's own identity - the same reasoning digitaldirection's carrier-based claim uses, not a bill-to roster.
